subunit: Homotetramer; each monomer provides an independent water pore. Component of the ankyrin-1 complex in the erythrocyte, composed of ANK1, RHCE, RHAG, SLC4A1, EPB42, GYPA, GYPB and AQP1. Interacts with EPHB2; involved in endolymph production in the inner ear. Identified in a complex with STOM. Interacts (via the N-terminal) with ANK1 (via ANK 1-5 repeats). Interacts (via the C-terminal) with EPB42
